I had a filling replaced by the Thai dentist at his practice.

Excellent work. Most importantly, I didn't feel the anesthetic injection at all, which is usually unpleasant. Perfect. Thank you so much!

I had treatment for acute toothache. I received comprehensive and expert advice.

Even with my limited knowledge, the treatment from the entire team was excellent.

I will return to address a more significant cosmetic issue that has been bothering me for a long time.

The dentist is German-speaking and experienced, and can bill in Germany.

There are certainly cheaper local dentists around Pattaya.

But none offer this complete package.

The price-performance ratio is excellent.

Suitable for medical tourists and vacationers, not just expats.

Sincerely, Daniel

Everyone involved was super-friendly and helpful.  We were coordinating our treatment from Australia and the process was straightforward and simple.  Very very happy with the treatment, pain levels (almost zero) and end result.  Heading back this year for my partners treatment.  Highly recommend this practice.

I've never received a dental prosthesis that fits perfectly right away.

I'd like to sincerely thank Dr. Ramin and his dental technician. The work couldn't be more professional. And of course, I mustn't forget the receptionist—he's nothing compared to Einstein.

However, things have deteriorated rapidly since they've been here permanently. This doctor is history for me. Now he doesn't even have a German dental technician anymore.
While on vacation, a crown fell out on an implant. I went to the clinic, and they reattached it in just a few minutes. They offered the best price, only 500 baht. I hope it lasts a long time.

I had an implant with a double crown and two professional cleanings. The implant placement went better than I expected. No pain. The crown was well-prepared and only minor adjustments were needed. Communication was possible in my native language (German), which was one of the reasons I chose Deutsche Dental. The cleaning was much more thorough than with other dentists, and I experienced less pain than usual. Highly recommended.
Beautiful and very clean practice, very friendly staff and a great doctor, thank you Doc Ramin 👍🏻 …

I have never doubted, and will never doubt, that Dr. Ramin, whom I esteem, is a good dentist.

However, I was so upset about the appointment scheduling last Thursday that I will refrain from future visits. And this despite the fact that I have been a satisfied patient for probably 20 years (including Munich office hours).

A four-unit bridge on my upper jaw came loose; I thought, okay, there are worse things, a phone call will suffice.

However, the receptionist gave me an appointment for next Monday. Four days later! Even after I pointed out that it was just a matter of fixing the bridge, he insisted: fully booked, no appointments – Monday or never!

Naturally, I then went to another practice; the actual time spent in the treatment room was about 10-15 minutes.

That the service was then free is just a side note, because I know that you catch more flies with honey than with vinegar.

In my opinion, the affable gentleman at reception lacked tact!

I don't accept the argument about the peak season; there's certainly room for improvement in the opening hours during the season.

But to streamline the administrative work (haha, no offense intended), it's fine with me if my patient file, as well as my wife's, is shredded!

text: A truly very pleasant appointment today with Dr. Ramin and his staff; in my opinion, I can wholeheartedly recommend them.
Doktor Ramin und seine Mitarbeiter sind kompetent und ganz tolle Menschen. Ich freue mich, sie kennen gelernt zu haben. Eine absolute Empfehlung!

I've had two appointments with Dr. Ramin and can wholeheartedly recommend him and his friendly team (it's worth the trip, even from afar!).

I'm absolutely thrilled with the result!!!
Excellent treatment and very professional work.

The German dental clinic in Pattaya, run by Dr. Ramin, comes highly recommended. He is a German dentist, highly qualified and very friendly. I received comprehensive advice regarding my dental problems and decided on telescopic dentures. They fit like my own teeth and were crafted with German precision. The entire staff is very friendly, and every appointment was scheduled according to my preferences.

Dr. Ramin provided me with a treatment and cost plan immediately during my consultation, which was approximately two-thirds less than what I would have received in Germany.

After almost three years of dental problems and visiting numerous clinics for suitable treatment, I finally found a solution.
Two months ago, Dr. Ramin fitted me with so-called telescope dentures. The treatment was quick and virtually painless. After two months, I'm very satisfied and regret not having this treatment done sooner. The dentures feel almost the same as my own teeth, are very beautiful, and I can eat virtually anything.
Thank you, Dr. Ramin (and Mr. Steve).

I went for my annual check-up today. Unfortunately, I had two cavities, but they were treated immediately so I wouldn't have to come back. The whole procedure was, as always, very quick and completely painless. Dr. Supanut is an excellent dentist, and the dental treatments are much more pleasant and painless than with my previous dentists in Switzerland.

The Deutsche Dental Clinic has the most modern and technically advanced equipment for cleaning teeth that I have ever seen. In fact, they were able to remove the stains on my lower front teeth that my dental hygienist in California was unable to remove.
I am very satisfied with Dr. Ramin; 11 new crowns, top quality.

Doctor Ramen is a top professional dentist. Root canal treatment, care, filling in 2 phases. I didn't feel a thing. He is very honest in his assessment. Gives an honest opinion about your teeth and what needs to be done. Tells it like it is. Can be trusted, unlike so many practices around here. They will see me back there.

Top service
Professional

Thanks to your team

A skilled dentist, I'll gladly come again. No "sales pressure" like with other dentists. The patient's well-being is the priority.
I was glad to visit this clinic. Very nice receptionist. Good and pleasant doctors and staff.
Clean your teeth regularly

I can highly recommend the German Dental Clinic in Pattaya.

The reception staff provides excellent advice right from the start. The precise work of the dentist and technician is outstanding.

I have never experienced such fantastic work in Germany.

Many thanks to the entire team!

I have been a patient of Dr. Ramin for more than 12 years. I have complete trust in the doctor.

A practice that is well-organized from A to Z,
from appointment to treatment.

As the saying goes:
Knowledge makes perfect.
But what do you say when you are:
Knowledgeable - Loves your job - Knows three languages.
Hard work - Excellent treatment - Professional.

Then you say: World champion, master of the international examination. Dr. Ramin deserves it.

I thank you very much.
++++++++ Appreciation and respect ++++++++
Very quick and efficient at repairing my broken denture.
Dr Ramin is very nice, very honest and very trustable Dentist with excellent knowledge. If you go to him you are in very good hands. I am retired Dentist from Germany too.

I was there because I had composite fillings done in Laos. They determined that they had fixed it so well that I could come to Germany for further treatment. If anyone wants treatment there, they should make an appointment in advance, as …
Excellent dentist, very nice, excellent work. I'm very satisfied and would come back anytime.

I came here because an implant had come loose and got an appointment quickly. It was great that they speak German. Dr. Ramim examined me and determined that an implant had indeed come loose. Unfortunately, he couldn't treat me further because he didn't have the tools for that particular manufacturer. However, he found a colleague who then took over my treatment. I've rarely encountered such a helpful doctor who goes to so much trouble. I can highly recommend this practice. 🙏👍

Highly recommended!

I recently got three appointments at the clinic very quickly. The consultation, treatment, and procedure with Dr. Ramin and his team were very professional, careful, and friendly. I'm usually quite anxious about dental appointments. However, the doctor and his team quickly put me at ease, and the results are fantastic!

5 stars

A very good dental practice; quality comes at a price.

I am very satisfied.

The staff is very courteous and helpful.

I went to this clinic for a root canal.

I was very pleased with everything: the receptionist was extremely polite and …

Never go to this clinic! The elderly white receptionist, with greasy, dirty hair, was a mean, negative man who started harassing me from the moment I walked in. If you have money, don't go to this clinic. They'll curse you, be rude, and throw you out on the street like a lousy homeless person. When I asked to make an appointment, the receptionist started yelling at me that they wouldn't see me there for any amount of money. I get my teeth done in the best clinics in Russia and Europe, I have the money for it. And I was treated horribly here. Leave this place, respect yourself, you deserve the best treatment for your money. By the way, I get my teeth treated in clinics that have a computer microscope, where everything is displayed on a big screen, all the images and all. At this clinic, they have no idea that teeth can be treated under a microscope. The doctors are not German, but Thai. The service at the clinic is like a back alley in a Brooklyn dump. Disgusting service. The receptionist should be fired immediately!!!! Maybe it wasn't the administrator, but the clinic director, then the shame is triple!!! The most negative attitude in this disgusting, vile clinic! Shame on the clinic!!!!

WARNING: You will NOT be treated by a German doctor! Apparently, minor procedures are only handled by a Thai doctor, while more complex cases are done by a German one. I made an initial appointment to have my pain checked out. I mentioned it might be a cavity, but I wasn't sure and it needed to be examined closely. I was surprised when I arrived and a Thai doctor suddenly came in. He searched for a cavity for a few seconds and found nothing. He then told me he would simply fill the gap between my teeth and that I might need a crown. I have had a lot of experience with dentists, and this was by far the worst. He didn't even take an X-ray to get a proper overview. In my opinion, this clinic shouldn't advertise that a German doctor with German-quality craftsmanship is on staff. Even more importantly, patients should be informed and asked beforehand if it's acceptable for a Thai doctor to perform the examination. I'm convinced that Thai dentists can do excellent work, but they often make poor decisions about which procedures are truly necessary. So please, a message to the clinic: Don't advertise with German doctors if you don't always have them available, and above all, inform or ask customers first if it's okay for a Thai doctor to perform the treatment! You'll save yourselves a lot of trouble and a lot of disgruntled customers!
...just the way you like a dental practice... Appointments required, therefore a small waiting area. Reception, two (very) well-equipped treatment rooms, two very nice dentists.

I've been a patient of Dr. Ramin Yachkaschi for years and can recommend him without reservation. Four years ago, I had a bridge and two crowns fitted – the appearance and comfort were perfect. His practice is friendly and modern, and he offers quick and reliable appointments, even for patients from Europe.

A truly excellent practice!
German-speaking staff and dentist.
My visit to the dentist was extremely pleasant and professional. The entire team was very friendly and accommodating, which immediately made me feel at ease. Just like being at home, which isn't the norm in Thailand. The dentist took ample time to answer my questions and explained each step of the treatment. I felt well cared for and had complete confidence in his expertise. The practice itself was modern and clean, which further contributed to my positive experience. I highly recommend this dentist and will definitely return.

I've already scheduled another appointment for dental treatment.

Excellent work.  I've have extensive work over a life time.  This is the very best.
Thank you
Very satisfied with this first experience (fitting a bridge). My dentist in Pattaya from now on!

I've been here recently and got a rot canal filling plus a normal filling. Excellent work and the newest equipment.
Maybe a bit excessive, but you get what you pay for.

A very friendly, helpful, and competent dentist who takes his time for his patients.

Good advice and, most importantly, pain-free treatment. I've finally found the right dentist. Many thanks also to the lovely staff!
Very friendly, very modern facilities. The examination was free.

I've been a patient of Dr. Ramin for years and have always been satisfied.

Ich kann die Deutsche Dental Clinic uneingeschränkt empfehlen.

Bei mir musste ein Zahn gezogen werden. Ob das ein "deutscher" oder ein "thailändischer" Zahnarzt macht, ist mir persönlich völlig egal – entscheidend ist das ** Ergebnis **. Und das war hier perfekt: Die Behandlung war komplett schmerzfrei (auch danach). Ich habe tatsächlich nicht einmal gemerkt, in welchem Moment der Zahn bereits draußen war.

Auch die Beratung vor der Behandlung war ausführlich und professionell. Die eigentliche Durchführung verlief schnell, ruhig und ohne unnötiges Tamtam.

Dazu kommen ein attraktiver Preis, eine sehr saubere und moderne Praxis. Ein besonderes Lob geht an Herren am Empfang – sympathisch, herzlich und mit echter Ausstrahlung. Solche Charaktermenschen machen den Unterschied.

Von mir gibt es deshalb eine klare Empfehlung und verdiente 5 Sterne!

Hinzu kommt ein eigenes Zahntechnik-Labor, wodurch schnellstmöglich Reparaturen und Herstellung neuer Prothesen möglich sind, meist innerhalb ein paar wenigen Stunden.
